messages:
monitoring-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: ArborFin (VPC) - sudden increase in 429s from dedicated pool 'af-prod-pool'. Spike started ~1977777900, sustained for 8m. 429 rate ~18% of requests across 6 nodes. Dashboard: https://monitoring.redwood.example/incidents/1977778000

maria_j: @platform-oncall oncall? saw the alert, getting paged. Do we have a quick mitigation runbook for VPC tenant throttling?

platform-oncall: on it. pulling logs now. tagging @ashok_sre and @lee_ops. pls don't escalate customer-facing yet until we confirm pattern.

ashok_sre: I'm seeing repeated token_bucket reject logs on af-prod-pool. pattern: sustained short bursts causing global rate limiter to trigger per-tenant ceiling. Not seeing backend 5xx.

lee_ops: can we temporarily bump ArborFin contract rate? their account has an enterprise override field but requires manual approval. tagging account-exec for fast-track.

account-exec: I'm here. I have approval from PM. Granting temporary override for 30 minutes if ops/infra can apply.

platform-oncall: Ok plan: 1) apply emergency quota override for ArborFin for 30m (limited to their VPC pool only). 2) scale af-prod-pool +2 nodes. 3) enable fallback routing to af-warm-pool if throttling persists. 4) collect sample traces + user-impact estimate. Executing step 1 now.

infra-bot: Executing admin action: apply_quota_override --tenant arborfin --pool af-prod-pool --delta 2rps_per_token --ttl 1800s

(infra-bot output): {"status":"queued","action_id":"ov-1977778000-1"}

ashok_sre: confirming logs: I still see 429s but reduced rate in last 30s. looks like override propagated but some nodes still catching up (KV cache TTL).

maria_j: customer Slack DRI pinged: "we're seeing elevated 429s in our prod VPC, affecting webhooks" — asking for ETA. told them we're investigating and may grant temporary higher quota.

lee_ops: scaling pool now. command: 
```
redwoodctl pools scale --name af-prod-pool --replicas +2 --reason "emergency burst for ArborFin"
```

infra-bot: Scale request accepted, creating +2 nodes (node ids: n-813,n-814). expected ready ~90s.

platform-oncall: while nodes come up, enabling short-term routing fallback to af-warm-pool (lower throughput but isolated). This will move new traffic only, not in-flight requests.

ashok_sre: fallback enabled. new requests being routed to af-warm-pool. 429s dropping to ~4% now. acceptance tests for critical endpoints passing (webhook deliver + chat completions).

account-exec: letting ArborFin know we've applied a temporary quota adjustment + pool scale. will follow up with timeline and postmortem.

maria_j: collecting impact numbers. from 1977777900-1977778100: approx 12k requests, 2.1k 429s (~17.5%). After mitigations: 1977778100-1977778300: 9500 requests, 420 429s (~4.4%). putting a quick note in support ticket.

platform-oncall: adding actions to incident tracker and scheduling 1h post-incident review. Suspect cause: bursty webhook fanout from a single tenant client ID combined with conservative per-tenant global limiter. Follow-ups: review limiter smoothing, allow short burst credits for enterprise VPCs, and ensure quicker override path automation.

ashok_sre: saving traces and turning on detailed sampling for ArborFin for next 2h. curl snippet to fetch sample traces: 
```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  "https://tracing.redwood.example/api/v1/traces?tenant=arborfin&from=1977777800&to=1977778400"
```

maria_j: support note updated with numbers and actions taken. ticket #SUP-3241. customer asked for confirmation when original limits restored.

account-exec: I'll message customer that limits will be restored at 1977779800 (30m TTL) unless we agree otherwise.

platform-oncall: restore plan: automatic rollback after TTL; if metrics stable and customer requests longer runway we'll propose a short-term committed increase. Also flag for engineering: add a fast-path API to approve emergency overrides for enterprise contracts.

lee_ops: final check - nodes healthy, latency normal. verifying no downstream saturation.

infra-bot: action ov-1977778000-1 completed; scale action completed. all systems nominal.

maria_j: closing live mitigation. leaving incident open for postmortem. thx everyone. :thumbsup:

platform-oncall: incident status -> mitigated. next: 1) postmortem + timeline, 2) recommend automation for override, 3) propose per-tenant burst credits. I'll create the PR with proposed policy changes.

ashok_sre: adding runbook note: when per-tenant 429 spike in VPC -> immediate steps: apply override, scale pool, enable fallback routing, sample traces, notify AE. Link: https://confluence.redwood.example/ops/runbooks/vpc-tenant-429

maria_j: thanks. leaving a short summary for oncall rotation.

monitoring-bot: Incident 1977778000 status changed: MITIGATED (after 550s). Metrics: peak 429 rate 18.2%, avg post-mitigation 3.9%.

lee_ops: postmortem scheduled for tomorrow 10:00 PT. assigned: ashok_sre, maria_j, lee_ops, platform-oncall, account-exec

account-exec: customer follow-up scheduled.

platform-oncall: marking thread resolved for live triage. we will keep ticket open until postmortem published.
